name: National Identification Number (NIN, Namba ya Utambulisho wa Taifa)
note: NIDA's own pages, read 2026-10-30: its home page tells resident foreigners aged 18 and over living in Tanzania on a residence document to come forward and register under the Registration and Identification of Persons Act, and says the National Identification Number (NIN) or the national identity card gives access to many social, economic and security services. NIDA's acting Director of Identification Management's presentation to ID4Africa (2018, NIDA's own slides as the ID4Africa site holds them): eligibility is all citizens, legal residents and refugees living in Tanzania aged 18 and over; the credentials are a unique 20-digit national ID number (NIN) and a smartcard. Read as given on registration, from 18, to citizens and residents (refugees aren't a separate class in the form). No check digit, structure of the digits, fee or time is stated; `needed` is left out, as the home page names no purpose that requires it.

sources.title: National Identification Authority (NIDA), home page
sources.said: Wageni Wakaazi wenye umri wa miaka 18 na zaidi wanaoishi nchini Tanzania kulingana na hati ya ukaazi wanaarifiwa kujitokeza Kusajiliwa kwa mujibu wa sheria ya Usajili na Utambuzi wa watu ... unaweza kutumia Namba yako ya Utambulisho wa Taifa (NIN)/Kitambulisho cha Taifa (NID) kupata huduma nyingi za kijamii, kiuchumi na kiusalama

sources.title: Alphonce Malibiche, Ag. Director, Identification Management, NIDA: Tanzania's Digital ID Ecosystem Roadmap (ID4Africa 2018)
sources.said: Eligibility: All citizens, legal residents and refugees living ... in Tanzania, aged 18 years and above ... Unique 20-digit national ID number (NIN)
